subject.statement: Rodrigo Rato, exdirector del FMI, fue condenado en 2024 por delitos contra la Hacienda Pública.

summary: Rodrigo Rato's known convictions relate to the 'black cards' case (misappropriation) and he was acquitted of tax fraud charges in 2023; there is no record of a 2024 conviction for crimes against public treasury.
